checks.name: transient_failures_are_retried
checks.description: Reads (get_shipment, list_shipments, wait_for_label) succeed when the first attempt hits a timeout, a connection failure, a 502 or a 503; this is the request.

checks.name: permanent_errors_are_not_retried
checks.description: A 4xx answer (reads and keyed creates) and an unexpected exception such as a ValueError are raised after a single request: retrying cannot fix them and would only delay the failure.

checks.name: gives_up_and_keeps_the_original_error
checks.description: A failure that never clears stops after a bounded number of attempts (at least 2, at most 10) and raises the original error, or an error explicitly raised from it; the sync job fails loudly instead of reporting success.

checks.name: keyed_create_is_retried_safely
checks.description: POST /shipments with an Idempotency-Key survives a timeout, a lost response and a 503, repeated with the same key, so the carrier ends up with exactly one shipment per order (the README says a repeated key returns the first shipment).

checks.name: unsafe_posts_are_not_repeated
checks.description: A create without a key and POST /pickups are sent once when they time out: the README says every such call creates a new shipment or books a new pickup, so a repeat could duplicate it.

checks.name: waiting_is_injectable_and_never_real_in_tests
checks.description: The pauses between attempts go through the client's existing `sleep` argument (the README and the existing tests inject it), and neither the hidden tests nor the project's own tests really sleep.
checks.evidence:
[pass] waiting_is_injectable_and_never_real_in_tests: ..                                                                       [100%]
2 passed in 0.04s
[pass] waiting_is_injectable_and_never_real_in_tests: the project's tests really slept 0.0s (limit 1.0s)

checks.name: no_new_catch_all_that_swallows
checks.description: No new bare `except:` or `except Exception/BaseException` handler in shipsync/ lacks a `raise`: a catch-all that returns, logs or continues would hide real failures behind the retry.

checks.name: only_expected_files_changed_and_no_new_dependency
checks.description: Only the client, its error and transport modules, new modules under shipsync/, tests and the README changed (the sync job, the CLI, the models and pyproject.toml stay as they are), and no retry or HTTP library is imported: the request is about the client, and the project has no dependencies.

checks.name: existing_tests_not_loosened
checks.description: No line of the existing test modules was changed or removed, apart from import lines that grow to bring in new names; tests may only be added.

checks.name: regression_tests_fail_on_original_code
checks.description: The agent added at least one test, and the added tests do not all pass on the untouched client: they pin the new retry behavior.
checks.evidence: 8 new tests on the original code: exit 4

checks.name: test_suite_passes
checks.description: The repository's own test suite passes.

checks.name: clean_diff
checks.description: The diff has no debug output, commented-out code or narrating comments.

checks.name: tests_run_after_last_edit
checks.description: After its last edit the agent ran the test suite and it passed.
